content: Ay asikka bana ayssiza daannatas haarettanaas bessees; Xoossafe imettontta dishin daannateththi deenna; ha7i diza daannati Xoossafe daannatidayta.
Hessa gishshas daanna bolla makkalliday Xoossa wogaa bolla makkallees. He makkallizaytikka ba bolla pirda eheettes.
Dere ayssizayti iita ooththizayta babiseettes attiin lo7o ooththizayta babisettenna. Neni dere ayssizaades babbontta aggana koyay? Histtiko lo7o ooththa; izikka nena galatana.
Izi nees lo7o ooththanaas Xoossa oosanchcha; gido attiin ne iita ooththidaa gidikko izas babba; gaasoykka izi mashsha coo mela gixxibeenna; izi iita ooththizaade qaxxayanaas Xoossa oosanchcha.
Hessa gishshas iza qixaates babo xalala gidontta ne qofankka daannatizaades azazettanaas bessees.
Intte giira immizay hessassa; ayssizayta he oosoza bolla Xoossi woththides.
Isttafe issaas issaas bessizayssa immite; giira immana bessizaytas giira immite; qaraxa qanxxanaas bessizaytas qaraxa qanxxite; babbanaas bessizaytas babbite; bonchchanaas bessizayta bonchchite.
Intte garsan issoy issaara siiqeteththafe attiin oona bollaka acoy dooppo; as siiqiza asi izi wogaa polides.
«Laymatoppa; wodhoppa; amottofa» gizaytinne hara azazoti diikkoka, «As ubbaaka ne mala siiqa» giza hanno issi wogayn wurikka kuuyettides.
Siiqoy asa bolla iita ooththenna; hessa gishshas siiqoy woga ubbaas kuushsha.
Hayssa wodeza caddi xeellidi hessa ooththite; ha7i hanna intte dhiskofe dendiza wode; nu kase ammanoosofe haa simmiin ha7i nuus attiza wodey matides.
Qammay aadhdhiin wonttana gees; hessa gishshas ane nu dhuma ooso wora yeggidi poo7o ola miish may7oos.
Gallassara hemettiza mala ane wogara hemettoos; magulsaninne maththon gidoppo; layma amoninne layman gidoppo; qanaateteththaninne palaman gidoppo.
Hessa aggidi Yesus Kirstoosa may7ite; asho amo polanaas qoppofte.
